  "citazione": "If rejects rise on ALL valves at the same time and the inlet flow oscillates, the cause is almost always upstream (unstable supply from the feed pump), not in the filler: check the feed pump before working on the valves.",
  "confidenza": 0.6,
  "azione_raccomandata": "Check the feed pump for stable supply first. If the pump is stable, inspect and clean the level probe optical sensor lens with isopropyl alcohol and re-align the laser sensor bracket. If rejects persist, open a ticket for further investigation.",
